caption: the marble line's modern peak - trifle trident aiming, glowing caverns and a 108-track campaign.
about: Sparkle unleashed (2016) is 10tons' marble shooter at full modern power: a two-orb trifle trident to aim with, chains that split across the screen's full width, and a hundred-plus track campaign tuned like a bullet-hell in slow motion. The power system returns as collectible trident upgrades, and the difficulty ranks remain the fairest in the genre.
The steam listing still sells the windows build - the live door for the modern half of the sparkle line.
